serverConnection.scope: Two clients on the same computer only; another computer requires the host computer address.
serverConnection.player1: Load the private world first and wait for loading to finish.
serverConnection.player2Menu: Играть > Сетевая игра > Показать все серверы > Прямое подключение
serverConnection.evidence: Both players joined same private world; Player2 direct join with LAN unchecked, clean restart and normal save/reload verified.
serverConnection.recovery: After server crash, a clean Nucleus/client restart with the same world restored Player1 connection; underlying cause remains unproven.

controllerRecovery.verification: Game-agent evidence and user confirmation; two PnP Xbox 360, XInput 0/1, unchanged mapping hash. Base read saved evidence.
controllerRecovery.gameplayAfterRecovery: Subsequent same-world entry of both saved V Rising characters verified under currentNetworkIncident. The controller recovery check itself established two XInput; no separate fresh full input/audio test is claimed.
controllerRecovery.cause: Original detection and license verification failures not established; no proven Steam Input conflict.

currentNetworkIncident.observed: Fresh session: server loaded existing world; Player2 joined; Player1 remained Connecting for at least five minutes. No preceding server crash.
currentNetworkIncident.evidence: Game-agent report and private evidence reviewed; raw logs not published.
currentNetworkIncident.cause: Unproven; not limited to post-crash retry. Early Player2 join, Steam and Raw Input not established as causes.
currentNetworkIncident.preservation: New autosave, full backup including .TEMP, normal Player2 exit then session shutdown.
currentNetworkIncident.attempt: Complete Nucleus/client/server restart; same profile/mode/world; wait for Player1 world entry, then connect Player2.
currentNetworkIncident.verification: Both existing characters restored with HasLocalCharacter=True and ShouldCreateCharacter=False; new autosave completed. Game-agent and user confirmation; base read final saved logs.
currentNetworkIncident.loadingDistinction: On successful retry Connecting screen remained while server was still loading and Player1 already had ConnectionUpdate Connected.

currentInputIncident.userReport: Both characters moved independently. Cursor crosstalk after A/RS was reproduced without End. User clarified the omission and confirmed it resolved after enabling End.
currentInputIncident.agentVerified: Final snapshot has XInput0/1. Bridge HIDE wasLocked=False before clarification; after real End HIDE wasLocked=True nowLocked=False. Subsequent SHOW leaves unlocked.
currentInputIncident.testProcedure: Verify two working virtual devices, then End once after windows load and test each player. Ctrl+F10 releases input; after showing via Ctrl+F10/F9 it remains unlocked. End toggles.
currentInputIncident.failedAttempts: Targeted remap on and original-profile apply to second returned success and saved Remap=true but initially did not restore XInput1. The first reported power cycle also failed; later user power cycle restored it as recorded under liveRecovery.
currentInputIncident.limitations: Specific OS mouse event source, Steam Input involvement and long-term stability unproven. Character movement transfer not confirmed.
currentInputIncident.currentRequirement: Manual End once after both windows load and after showing through Ctrl+F10/F9; no automatic relock implemented.
currentInputIncident.runtimeChange: Public handler Description text only; execution logic and common bridge unchanged.

liveRecovery.sequence: Remap on and unchanged profile apply to second alone did not recreate XInput; after later user power cycle it returned.
liveRecovery.verification: Two PnP Xbox OK, XInput0/1, Remap true/true. Both clients and server retained process ID and creation time.
liveRecovery.restarts: No game, server, Steam or reWASD service restart performed.
liveRecovery.limitations: Root cause, necessity of each step and lasting stability unknown. Keep-virtual option not changed or tested.
liveRecovery.failedKeyboardFallback: Show windows and click second window without End did not restore WASD; mouse alone responded.

controllerRecurrence.observed: Steam registered physical connection; only one virtual Xbox appeared. Profile and Slot1 unchanged.
controllerRecurrence.failedAttempt: Power cycle failed; Steam closure and targeted apply returned success without second XInput. After guarded offline jlserv restart, both apply returned license error; normal-user retry also failed.
controllerRecurrence.nextSteps: Full interactive repair shortcut flow on the next actual failure remains untested.
controllerRecurrence.cause: Original detection and license failures unproven; no proven Steam conflict.
controllerRecurrence.recovery: After user activation apply succeeded but second Xbox still absent. Targeted reset of one receiver switched controllers off; user powered both on, restoring both Xbox/XInput. Steam returned and result persisted.
